## Design

### 2026-10-17 – # FINALLY finished 80 % of the design...

**4h**

# FINALLY finished 80 % of the design...

Lately I have been working on my project, the escape. A small puzzle box that contains a hidden message inside.

I started by researching about the different mechanism of puzzle boxes to help me understand their construction better. Since I wanted a design of my own , I started sketching numerous ideas, collecting inspiration online and choosing the mechanism for the puzzle box.

![sketches](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/2nSU0FeFWUdKhTj1YkXaIuxV7KZ67ZbK/c892a281717b096a5fc8acd130a8ac4819e83f3dea14b877703b664ecfc33631.jpg)

This initial step was rather chaotic but necessary  because after I had a sketch that was the foundation of the next steps.

For designing I used Onshape, the same online software used in the merble guide. Before I could start with designing I had to learn how to navigate on this software programm, which was sort of challeging.
Though some youtube tutorials did the job.

![prototype](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/2nSU0FeFWUdKhTj1YkXaIuxV7KZ67ZbK/6a176943a08906f25cd42aeaa02d2092475734e4060c5381e8dba92c00689733.png)

The most challenging part for now was with out a doubt determining the function of each individual pieces and how each would interlock in each other.

During the research phase, I wrote a solution path for the cube using a binary system , which I believed would be useful for the future.

![path](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/2nSU0FeFWUdKhTj1YkXaIuxV7KZ67ZbK/1888545b338eac65e7ef6bc7207b11f5d157b57b1c8cf9db7f8675510d375d44.jpg)

It wasn't ...

The Idea of writing the rules and path in a binary system is neither ineffective nor is it great. It largely depends on the puzzle and its designer. Now looking back I should've experimented with different methods from the beginning instead of investing too much time on theory

For me reverse engineering proved to be the most effective approach .

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 214938](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/2nSU0FeFWUdKhTj1YkXaIuxV7KZ67ZbK/c42aee8daa11de74fccc4b6a0afea2e58844af372d69ee2417c25e989a4b24ad.png)

## Next ...

My next steps are finishing the project.

I still need to edit each piece precisely so that everything fits exactly how it should.
